scoring_justification: Elastic constants and polycrystalline moduli are compared to paper gold with tolerances. Phonon frequencies are checked structurally (36 positive frequencies, no imaginary modes, three acoustic zeros). Full recompute of moduli from elastic constants is not done because of complex Reuss shear formula, but T0 is acceptable.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold reference values for elastic constants and polycrystalline moduli; expected structural properties for phonon file.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Table 2 (elastic constants C_ij, polycrystalline moduli B, G, E, σ, B/G, H_v and bounds). C66 = (C11-C12)/2 derived from symmetry. Phonon properties inferred from paper Table 3 (all positive frequencies, three acoustic modes).
hidden_assets.generation_method: Elastic constants and moduli values are extracted from the paper's reported numbers. Phonon structural target is derived from the paper's claim of dynamical stability and irreducible representation analysis.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: All values directly correspond to the paper's published table, which is the target of reproduction. No fabricated numbers.

outputs.description: Single-crystal elastic constants C_ij for trigonal Li4P2S6. The checker compares these to the paper's reported values with an absolute tolerance.
Voigt-Reuss-Hill averaged polycrystalline moduli, Poisson's ratio, B/G ratio, and Vickers hardness. The checker compares these to reference values within tolerances.
Γ-point phonon frequencies. The checker verifies all frequencies are positive real numbers and has_imaginary_modes is false, indicating dynamical stability.

output_contract.notes: The task uses open-source Quantum ESPRESSO instead of the paper's proprietary CASTEP. Systematic differences are absorbed by the tolerances specified on the scoring side (hidden). Only the elastic constants, polycrystalline moduli, Vickers hardness, and Γ-point phonon frequencies are required; anisotropy, dielectric tensors, thermodynamic properties, and minimum thermal conductivity are excluded per the taskability scope.

steps.description: Compare each independent elastic constant against paper reference with absolute tolerance
Compare each reported polycrystalline modulus/hardness against paper reference, with relative tolerances for moduli (5%) and absolute tolerances for dimensionless/hardness
Verify the phonon file contains exactly 36 frequencies, all non-negative, has_imaginary_modes is false, and exactly three zero/near-zero acoustic modes
